description: Defines classes and functions for logging and informational output within the ANGLE project's shader compiler translator component, including TInfoSinkBase and TInfoSink classes.

classes.name: TInfoSinkBase
classes.description: Provides methods for logging messages, including operator overloads for various data types, and manages an internal string sink.

classes.name: TInfoSink
classes.description: Contains instances of TInfoSinkBase for info, debug, and object logs.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloaded operator to append various data types to the sink, including strings, characters, floats, and booleans.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the sink string.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns the current sink string as a constant reference.

methods.name: c_str
methods.description: Returns the sink string as a C-style string.

methods.name: prefix
methods.description: Sets the severity prefix for logs.

methods.name: location
methods.description: Sets the location (file and line number) for logs.
